No EIP-1967 implementation, admin or beacon slot is set.

Immutability checkpoint 2 of 4: bytecode keccak256 remains 0xa3ed78c2deb7d2c3197c7f1f83847c7a2e806273099255078f11d84387b70ab9 at block 18,923,165, one year after checkpoint 1, with a 14,879.27 DODO transfer executed in the same block; no proxy upgrade, role mutation or pause event intervenes in the contract's history.

Immutability checkpoint 3 of 4: runtime code is again the identical 1,995-byte bytecode (keccak256 0xa3ed78c2deb7d2c3197c7f1f83847c7a2e806273099255078f11d84387b70ab9) at block 22,613,322, which also carries a 10,226.01 DODO transfer; the contract exposes no owner, minter or upgrade authority that could have altered it.

Immutability checkpoint 4 of 4: bytecode hash is unchanged at block 26,445,404 with a 1,359.71 DODO transfer in-block, and storage slots for name, symbol, decimals and totalSupply read at head block 26,455,938 are byte-identical to block 16,322,532, confirming zero mint, burn or metadata mutation across the full 2023-2026 window.

evidence_sources.claim_summary: Final content update to the canonical deployment registry docs/deployedInfo.md in DODOEX/docs; the registry documents only V1/V2-era contracts and the DODO token, and was never extended to any later contract generation.

Commit 'redirect docs.dodoex.io' retired the canonical Docusaurus documentation; the repository HEAD remains this redirect merge (PR #84), so the frozen 2021 deployment registry is the final state of the canonical docs repo.

Commit 'update README: add audit report' in DODOEX/dodo-v3 published the Sherlock-audited DODO V3 codebase (audit conducted 2023-06-19 to 2023-07-01); no V3 deployment record was ever added to the canonical docs registry in DODOEX/docs.

The replacement docs platform now lists DODO V3 contract addresses, confirming the repair happened off-repo on a new platform while the canonical GitHub deployment registry remains frozen at its 2021 state.

gap_windows.summary: Canonical deployment documentation gap: the DODOEX/docs registry froze at its 2021-12-28 state and the docs were redirected offline on 2023-08-09, one month before the audited DODO V3 codebase was published (2023-09-20); no commit in the canonical repo ever recorded the V3 contract generation, leaving the registry gap open for 1,199 days through 2026-11-20.

executive_risk_memo: DODO AMM's Pacta-pinned control-plane surface, the DODO token at 0x43Dfc4159D86F3A37A5A4B3D4580b888ad7d4DDd, is a fully immutable, non-upgradeable ERC-20: archive-RPC reads at blocks 16,324,054 (2023-01-03), 18,923,165 (2024-01-03), 22,613,322 (2025-06-02) and 26,445,404 (2026-11-19) return byte-identical 1,995-byte runtime code (keccak256 0xa3ed78c2deb7d2c3197c7f1f83847c7a2e806273099255078f11d84387b70ab9), with no EIP-1967 implementation, admin or beacon slot set, no owner principal, and metadata plus totalSupply storage unchanged between blocks 16,322,532 and 26,455,938 — the supply has remained exactly 1,000,000,000 DODO with zero mint or burn across the entire 2023-2026 window, eliminating upgrade-key and inflation risk for this asset while also making any latent defect permanently unpatchable. The material weaknesses are documentary and organisational rather than cryptographic: the canonical deployment registry in DODOEX/docs froze on 2021-12-28, the docs were redirected offline on 2023-08-09, and that registry gap has remained unrepaired in-repo for 1,199 days even though a replacement platform now lists V3 addresses. Engineering bench strength is thin: DODOEX/contractV2 recorded zero commits in the trailing twelve months (its last maintenance commit, on 2025-11-12 by a single engineer, fell eight days outside the window), the DODO V3 repository has been dormant since 2024-02-20, and recent core maintenance concentrates in one author, giving an effective bus factor near one for the deployed AMM generation despite a DefiLlama-measured TVL of about $14.1M.
